speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe any unusual physical features you have noticed, such as differences in height between your arms and legs or joint flexibility. Additionally, have you experienced any fractures from minor bumps or falls?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (Classic Salt-Wasting or Simple Virilizing form) presenting with delayed puberty and virilization.

I am surprised to see you on an oral contraceptive; have you ever had blood pressure monitoring or electrolyte tests (specifically sodium and potassium) performed to rule out adrenal insufficiency? Also, do you have any family members with similar physical features or infertility issues?
